<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/media.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';

$attachment_ids = get_posts( array(
	'post_type'   => 'attachment',
	'post_status' => 'any',
	'numberposts' => -1,
	'fields'      => 'ids',
) );
foreach ( $attachment_ids as $attachment_id ) {
	wp_delete_attachment( $attachment_id, true );
}

$files = array(
	'https://web-soudan.co.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/for_DEMO-Movie.mp4',
	'https://web-soudan.co.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/for_DEMO-pdf.pdf',
);
foreach ( $files as $file_url ) {
	$tmp_file = download_url( $file_url );
	if ( is_wp_error( $tmp_file ) ) {
		continue;
	}
	$file_array = array(
		'name'     => basename( $file_url ),
		'tmp_name' => $tmp_file,
	);
	$new_attachment_id = media_handle_sideload( $file_array, 0 );
	if ( is_wp_error( $new_attachment_id ) ) {
		@unlink( $file_array['tmp_name'] );
	}
}

注釈: WordPress PlaygroundのPHP実行環境に Imagick（+ Ghostscript）が入っていないため、PDFのプレビューは行えないため、実際のインストール型のWordPressの必要があります。

<?php
/*
Plugin Name: Demo New Post Redirect
Description: 新規投稿画面を開いた際に、あらかじめ公開しておいた記事の編集画面へ自動的に転送します。
*/

add_action( 'load-post-new.php', function () {
	if ( ! empty( $_GET['post_type'] ) && 'post' !== $_GET['post_type'] ) {
		return;
	}

	$post_id = (int) get_option( 'wsd_demo_draft_post_id' );

	if ( $post_id && get_post( $post_id ) ) {
		wp_safe_redirect( admin_url( 'post.php?post=' . $post_id . '&action=edit' ) );
		exit;
	}
} );
